standard.summary: PCIe Delta/Cache 模式（pcie_delta_cache_mode）：下列可选值说明含换档影响。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.observe: 只看信号，不改缓存语义。

standard_en.summary: The PCIe Delta/Cache mode (pcie_delta_cache_mode): the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.observe: Watches the signals only, without changing cache semantics.
optionDescriptions.cache_v0: Turns the v0 cache experiment on.
